title: Vegetable and Pasta Soup
description: A rich, filling soup of root vegetables, zucchini and tomatoes, finished by cooking the pasta in the soup so it thickens the broth. Garnish with parsley.

steps.text: Heat the olive oil in a pot over low heat. Add the finely chopped onion, coarsely grated carrots, diced parsley root and diced tomatoes and saute for about 10 minutes, stirring.
Add the diced potatoes, sweet potato and zucchini along with the stock (or water) and bring to the boil. Reduce the heat, cover and cook for about 20 minutes.
Cook the pasta in another pot of boiling water for half the time on the packet. Drain well and add to the soup. Cover and cook for about 2 more minutes. Season with salt and pepper.
Garnish with chopped parsley and serve.
